_about: P833 Call Receiver config. By Ethan Brady & Ryan Raikes. Installed at /etc/p833-receiver/config.json. Restart the service after editing: sudo systemctl restart p833-receiver

audio._note: Page = lead_silence_ms of silence (0: the paging feedback eliminator records from the start), then the department tone (per code, see codes.tone; once, twice or off), English, Spanish, played 'repeat' times. Keep every pause short (tone_gap_ms, lang_gap_ms, repeat_gap_ms): the feedback eliminator ends a page at a silence. Voice clips: tools/make_audio.py; tones: audio/tones/single.

phone._note: HT813 phone step settings. Easier to tune on the admin page, which saves its own values on top of these.

floor._note: Floor page from the ATA2 (ext 5912): Link (hook flash, 300 ms on the HT813), *60 general page, 2 = speakers, 1 = zone 1. Same as PAGE, SPEAKER, 1 on a Norstar desk phone. Found on the floor; can be changed on the admin page.
